required_contract: Require a valid bucket and project it into the exact signed resource target.
Require a nonempty key and preserve greedy path encoding in the signed target.
Preserve outer absence versus a present bounded Retention XML document.
Admit only the pinned requester token and sign its exact header.
Project the optional bounded generation selector exactly once.
Preserve absence versus explicit true and false governance bypass.
Always sign exact MD5 over owned serialized bytes and validate any caller override.
Admit all ten exact algorithms and sign each matching digest header over identical bytes.
Project and sign the optional bounded owner precondition.
Preserve absence or encode only exact GOVERNANCE and COMPLIANCE values.
Preserve absence or encode only exact pinned ISO-8601 timestamp text.
Decode at most one exact nonempty requester result header.
